name: Publish a web app to the App Cloud
description: Publish a web app so it opens inside JARVIS on every machine: write and enable a systemctl --user unit (Linux) or a launch command (macOS, Windows), wait for the app's /healthz, and register it in the App Cloud with a description and tags. This is the standing rule for anything with a web UI. Refuses to take over another app's id or a unit file it did not write unless force is set.

port.description: the port the app listens on (127.0.0.1)

command.description: the command line that starts the server, e.g. node server.js

env.description: environment variables for the server: NAME: "value"

description.description: what the applet does, so tool_list finds it

systemd.description: false to skip the unit and register a launch command only

waitSec.description: how long to wait for the health check, default 30

force.description: repoint an existing id or replace a unit this tool did not write

dryRun.description: show the unit file and registration without writing anything

outputs: { ok, steps[], healthStatus, unit, unitPath, path: /api/nodes/<node>/apps/<id>/ } or { ok: false, error }
